User Story (Requirement): As a startup founder, I want the system to search the live web for competitors and industry benchmarks, so that my validation is grounded in real-time market data rather than static LLM hallucinations.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Formulates optimized queries extracting industry keywords. 2. Queries Tavily Search Index when API keys exist. 3. Synthesizes offline fallback when offline. 4. Returns clean domain citations.

User Story (Requirement): As a backend service, I want to distill raw user prompts into targeted boolean search queries, so that Tavily returns high-precision competitive intelligence.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Filters noise words and appends target industry/competitor tokens. 2. Strips punctuation and maintains optimal query length under 180 characters.

User Story (Requirement): As a DevOps engineer, I want multi-provider LLM fallback resilience (Gemini/Groq/Offline Heuristic), so that the API never fails even if rate limits or quota drops occur.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Tries primary LLM endpoint. 2. Gracefully falls back to heuristic domain knowledge if offline. 3. Zero 500 error crashes.

User Story (Requirement): As a frontend developer, I want a standardized REST API with CORS, Pydantic validation, and health check endpoints, so that the client can reliably query pipeline execution.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. FastAPI app initialized with CORS middleware. 2. GET /health returns status 200. 3. Pydantic request models for idea submissions.

User Story Title: TAM / SAM / SOM Market Sizing Agent
User Story (Requirement): As an investor or founder, I want estimated market sizing broken into TAM, SAM, and SOM with CAGR growth rates, so that I can assess commercial viability and addressable opportunity.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Calculates TAM, SAM, SOM with credible CAGR percentages. 2. Identifies primary & secondary customer segments. 3. Differentiates Decision Makers from Daily Users.

User Story (Requirement): As a product strategist, I want a comparative matrix of direct and indirect competitors with identified market gaps, so that I can position my startup in unoccupied white space.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Identifies >=2 direct and >=2 indirect competitors with strengths, weaknesses, and pricing. 2. Plots 2x2 matrix coordinates. 3. Extracts top 3 high-value market white spaces.

User Story Title: Target Customer Persona & Pain Point Extraction
User Story (Requirement): As a UX researcher, I want deeply profiled user personas with explicit pain points and willingness-to-pay triggers, so that early product design addresses genuine customer friction.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Generates 2 distinct customer personas. 2. Quantifies pain point intensity and current workaround costs.

User Story (Requirement): As a user, I want a live visual step indicator showing which AI agent is executing in the pipeline DAG, so that I have clear visibility into analysis progress.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Animated SVG/CSS node progress indicator. 2. Real-time active step highlight with duration timer.

User Story (Requirement): As a venture analyst, I want a complete SWOT matrix coupled with Technical, Market, Legal, and Financial risk mitigations, so that I can stress-test the concept before capital commitment.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Produces 4 SWOT quadrants. 2. Categorizes risks into 4 distinct domains with severity scores (Low/Med/High). 3. Generates actionable mitigation playbooks.

User Story Title: MoSCoW & Effort vs Impact MVP Agent
User Story (Requirement): As a CTO / Lead Engineer, I want MVP features scored by Effort (1-10) and Impact (1-10) and categorized into MoSCoW, so that the team can scope a 30-to-60 day build sprint.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Sorts features into Must-Have, Should-Have, Could-Have, Won't-Have. 2. Assigns Effort/Impact scores with Quick-Win/Strategic tags. 3. Outlines 30-day and 60-day roadmaps.

User Story (Requirement): As a growth marketer, I want customer acquisition channel CAC metrics and a First 100 Customers playbook, so that the founding team has an actionable day-1 launch playbook.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Formulates positioning statement. 2. Evaluates top acquisition channels with estimated CAC. 3. Outlines 4 concrete steps to acquire first 100 paying customers.

User Story (Requirement): As a founder, I want an interactive multi-turn AI advisor that understands my entire validation dossier, so that I can ask follow-up questions regarding unit economics and defensibility.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Ingests full validation state as system context. 2. Multi-turn conversation memory. 3. Suggests 3 contextual follow-up prompt pills.

User Story Title: Market Viability Index & Radar Gauge UI
User Story (Requirement): As an executive, I want an aggregate Viability Score (0-100%) with radar metrics, so that I can immediately judge if an idea is high, medium, or low potential.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Feasibility, Market Demand, and Defensibility radial meters. 2. Overall composite score with color badge.
